title: Engineering precision.
Architectural expression.
en.intro: The Design Lab designs, engineers and fabricates advanced 3D façade systems for commercial and residential buildings. We bring depth, texture and sculptural geometry to architectural envelopes, combining creative vision with the precision of engineering.
en.intro2: Our full service partnership takes your project from consultation and parametric modelling to 3D visualisation, physical sampling, production and site installation. Every fold, pattern and junction is developed to turn an architectural idea into a carefully crafted surface.
en.projectDesc: A bold first impression. Folded geometric panels bring depth, rhythm and a distinctive golden finish to this entrance.

comparison.title: Before and After
comparison.instructions: Drag the handle to compare the façade during construction and after completion.

en.galleryDesc: See TDL’s folded metal panels up close, from fabrication in the workshop to the finished façades at Olkai Coffee Roasters and Debre Birhan MESOB Center.
en.expertIntro: One coordinated partnership, from the first conversation to installation on site. Our workflow combines computational design, hands on experimentation and specialist metalworking.
serviceDesc: Define the architectural direction, project requirements and desired character of your building’s exterior.
Develop customised forms, patterns and panel geometry using 3D modelling and computational design tools.
Explore the proposed façade through detailed digital models, visualisations and video before production.
Study folds and patterns through paper models and physical samples, refining design and detail before approval.
Translate the approved concept into metal components, with powder coated finishes for visual consistency and surface protection.
Bring the components together on site with attention to assembly, panel intersections and the finished architectural expression.
en.materialText: TDL integrates high grade powder coating into façade production. Smooth, uniform textures and project specific colours support the architectural vision, while the coating helps resist corrosion, chipping and scratching. The catalogue describes a solvent free finishing process.
en.processTitle: From paper model to real metal.
stepDesc: Discuss the building, design intent and project requirements.
Develop the parametric geometry and review 3D visualisations and video.
Test folds, patterns and details with physical models and samples.
Fabricate the approved components and apply the selected surface finish.
Assemble the façade on site, bringing the approved design into the built environment.
en.contactText: From a hospitality frontage to a residential entrance or a large civic façade, tell us what you have in mind. Our team can discuss custom design, manufacturing and installation for your next architectural vision.

en.footer: TDL Engineering PLC · The Design Lab
en.aboutText: A 3D façade introduces depth, texture and geometry to a building’s exterior. At TDL, advanced modelling and parametric design meet practical experimentation to create customised building skins for commercial and domestic projects. The catalogue also describes 3D printing as a tool used in some cases.
en.teamText: Our specialist team combines metalworking and façade assembly experience with close attention to the details. From testing a paper pattern to fine tuning metal intersections on site, the human touch is part of every architectural statement.
en.projectsText: Four projects from our company catalogue, showing the development of TDL’s work from its first 3D façade in 2024 to an 18 metre tall civic project in 2026.
en.applicationsText: The catalogue shows façade patterns applied to entrance gateways, ceilings and architectural metalwork. It also features metal and signage work, extending the same attention to detail into the way people arrive at and identify a place.

projectData.name: Fuyat Hotel
projectData.location: Torhailoch, behind Muluwongel Church, Addis Ababa
projectData.title: Where it all began.
projectData.text:
TDL’s first 3D façade project brought a carefully produced and installed geometric pattern to Fuyat Hotel in Torhailoch. The project established the company’s focus on quality and detail.

This was our first 3D façade. The challenge was to keep the folded pattern consistent across the building face, so the individual panels read as one surface from the street.

projectData.name: Olkai Coffee Roasters
projectData.location: Mekanissa, inside Mekane Yesus Church, Addis Ababa
projectData.title: A backdrop for a distinctive brand.
projectData.text:
A façade that connects coffee culture with three dimensional design. The project translates the client’s vision into a patterned architectural frontage and an expressive setting for the brand.

Look closely and you can see coffee bean shapes cut into the gold panels. The pattern carries around the entrance and the roastery sign, giving the storefront a detail that belongs to the business inside.

projectData.name: Hillside Real Estate
projectData.location: Sarbet, behind Kaizen Institute, Addis Ababa
projectData.title: A sculptural welcome.
projectData.text:
Intricate 3D patterns transform the main residential entrance into a sculptural gateway. The design creates an inviting transition from the city into the homes beyond.

The pattern wraps from the columns to the underside of the canopy. In daylight you see the depth of the folds. After dark, warm light traces the same geometry and makes the entrance easy to spot from the street.

projectData.name: Debre Birhan MESOB Center
projectData.title: Engineering at a larger scale.
projectData.text:
Delivered in collaboration with Ethio Global Construction, this 238 m² façade forms part of the MESOB Center, which stands 18 metres tall. TDL’s scope covered initial design, precision production and site installation.

We worked with Ethio Global Construction from design through fabrication and installation. The vertical strips set a rhythm across the building, and the folded metal catches the light differently as you walk past.

projectData.title: ልዩ አቀባበል።
projectData.text:
ዝርዝር 3D ቅርጾች ዋናውን የመኖሪያ መግቢያ ወደ ልዩ በር ይቀይራሉ። ከከተማው ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች የሚደረገውን ሽግግር ማራኪ ያደርጋሉ።

ንድፉ ከአምዶቹ ተነስቶ እስከ መግቢያ ጣሪያው ሥር ይዘልቃል። በቀን የታጠፉት ፓነሎች ጥልቀት ይታያል። ማታ ደግሞ ሞቅ ያለ ብርሃን ቅርጾቹን በማጉላት መግቢያውን ከመንገድ ለማየት ቀላል ያደርገዋል።

projectData.name: Debre Birhan MESOB Center
projectData.title: ምህንድስና በትልቅ ደረጃ።
projectData.text:
ከኢትዮ ግሎባል ኮንስትራክሽን ጋር በመተባበር የተሠራው 238 ካሬ ሜትር የሕንፃ ገጽታ የ18 ሜትር ከፍታ ያለው የመሶብ ማዕከል አካል ነው። የቲዲኤል ሥራ ከመጀመሪያ ንድፍ እስከ ማምረትና ተከላ ድረስ ነበር።

ከንድፍ ጀምሮ እስከ ምርትና ገጠማ ድረስ ከኢትዮ ግሎባል ኮንስትራክሽን ጋር ሠርተናል። ቀጥ ብለው የተደረደሩት ፓነሎች ለሕንፃው ወጥ ንድፍ ይሰጣሉ። በእግር ሲያልፉ የታጠፈው ብረት ብርሃኑን በተለያየ መልኩ ያንጸባርቃል።

title: Sirrummaa injinariingii.
Ibsa arkiteekcharii.
om.intro: The Design Lab gamoowwan daldalaa fi jireenyaatiif fuuldura gamoo 3D ammayyaa dizaayinii godha, hojii injinariingii irratti hojjeta, ni oomisha. Mul’ata kalaqaa fi sirrummaa injinariingii walitti fiduun gamoowwaniif gad fageenya, boca fi bareedina kennina.
om.intro2: Tajaajilli keenya gorsa, moodeela paaraameetirikii, agarsiisa 3D fi viidiyoo, saamuda qabatamaa, oomishaa fi dhaabbii iddoo hojii hammata. Dachaafama, boca fi walitti hidhamiinsa hunda of eeggannoon qopheessina.
om.projectDesc: Mul’ata jalqabaa adda ta’e. Paaneeloonni boca ji’oomeetirii qaban balbala seensaa kanaaf gad fageenya, sirna fi bareedina warqee kennu.

om.galleryDesc: Paaneelota sibiilaa TDL, hojii oomishaa irraa kaasee hanga fuuldura gamoo Olkai Coffee Roasters fi Giddugala MESOB Debre Birhanitti, dhiyeenyaan ilaalaa.
om.expertIntro: Marii jalqabaa irraa hanga dhaabbii iddoo hojiitti tajaajila walitti hidhame. Dizaayinii kompiitaraa, yaalii qabatamaa fi ogummaa hojii sibiilaa walitti fidna.
serviceDesc: Kallattii dizaayinii, fedhii pirojektii fi amala fuuldura gamoo keessanii irratti mari’anna.
Meeshaalee moodeela 3D fi dizaayinii kompiitaraa fayyadamuun bocawwan fi paaneelota addaa qopheessina.
Oomisha dura moodeelota dijitaalaa, suuraawwan 3D fi viidiyoodhaan yaada fuuldura gamoo ilaalaa.
Moodeelota waraqaa fi saamudota qabatamaa fayyadamuun dachaafama, boca fi bal’ina qoranna.
Yaada mirkanaa’e gara kutaalee sibiilaatti jijjiirra. Dibata paawudarii fayyadamuun bifa wal simaa fi eegumsa kennina.
Walitti hidhamiinsa paaneelotaa fi bifa xumuraatiif xiyyeeffannoo kennuun kutaalee iddoo hojii irratti walitti qabna.
om.materialText: TDL oomisha fuuldura gamoo keessatti dibata paawudarii qulqullina qabu fayyadama. Bifa sirrii fi halluu pirojektiif filatameen mul’ata dizaayinii deeggara; dibatichi daandii dandamannaa daalacha, caccabuu fi sararamuu gargaaru kenna. Kaataaloogiin adeemsa xumuraa solventii irraa bilisa ta’e ibsa.
stepDesc: Waa’ee gamoo, kaayyoo dizaayinii fi fedhii pirojektii mari’anna.
Boca paaraameetirikii qopheessinee agarsiisa 3D fi viidiyoo ilaalla.
Moodeelota fi saamudota qabatamaa fayyadamuun dachaafamaa fi bal’ina qoranna.
Kutaalee mirkanaa’an oomishnee xumura filatame hojiirra oolchina.
Dizaayinii mirkanaa’e gamoo irratti walitti qabnee dhaabna.

om.contactText: Fuuldura hoteelaa, seensa mana jireenyaa yookaan gamoo uummataa guddaa yaaddanii? Waa’ee dizaayinii addaa, oomishaa fi dhaabbii pirojektii keessanii waliin haa mari’annu.
om.name: Maqaa keessan
om.formNote: Agarsiisni kun gaaffii garagalchuu dandeessan qopheessa. Ergaa hin ergu.
om.footer: TDL Engineering PLC · The Design Lab
om.aboutText: Fuuldurri gamoo 3D gad fageenya, boca fi miidhagina gamoo dabala. TDL moodeela ammayyaa fi dizaayinii paaraameetirikii yaalii qabatamaa waliin walitti fiduun gamoowwan daldalaa fi jireenyaatiif haguuggii addaa uuma. Kaataaloogiin haala tokko tokko keessatti maxxansa 3D fayyadamuus ni ibsa.
om.teamText: Gareen keenya muuxannoo hojii sibiilaa fi dhaabbii fuuldura gamoo xiyyeeffannoo bal’inaa waliin walitti fida. Boca waraqaa qorachuu irraa hanga walitti hidhamiinsa sibiilaa iddoo hojii irratti sirreessuutti, ogummaan namaa hojii hunda keessatti hirmaata.
om.projectsText: Pirojektoota afur kaataaloogii dhaabbata keenyaa keessaa: hojii fuuldura gamoo 3D jalqabaa bara 2024 irraa hanga gamoo uummataa meetira 18 ol dheeratu bara 2026tti.
om.applicationsText: Kaataaloogiin bocawwan fuuldura gamoo seensa balbalaa, saqafaa fi hojii sibiilaa irratti fayyadamuu agarsiisa. Hojii sibiilaa fi mallattoo daldalaas ni hammata.

projectData.name: Fuyat Hotel
projectData.location: Torhailoch, duuba Mana Kiristaanaa Muluwongel, Finfinnee
projectData.title: Bakka hundi itti jalqabe.
projectData.text:
Pirojektiin fuuldura gamoo 3D jalqabaa TDL Torhailoch keessatti hojjetame. Boca of eeggannoon oomishamee fi dhaabameen xiyyeeffannoo dhaabbatichi qulqullinaa fi bal’inaaf kennu hundeesse.

Kun hojii fuula gamoo 3D keenya isa jalqabaa ture. Boca paanaaliiwwan dachaafamanii guutummaa fuula gamoo irratti wal simsiisne. Kanaaf karaa irraa yeroo ilaalaman akka fuula tokkootti mul’atu.

projectData.name: Olkai Coffee Roasters
projectData.location: Mekanissa, keessa Mana Kiristaanaa Mekane Yesus, Finfinnee
projectData.title: Bakka eenyummaa daldalaa ibsu.
projectData.text:
Fuuldura gamoo aadaa bunaa fi dizaayinii 3D walitti fidu. Mul’ata maamilaa gara fuuldura gamoo boca qabu fi eenyummaa daldalaa ibsutti jijjiira.

Dhiyeenyaan yoo ilaaltan, paanaaliiwwan halluu warqee qaban irratti boca firii bunaa ni argitu. Bocni kun naannoo balbala seensaafi mallattoo mana buna waaduu irratti itti fufa.

projectData.name: Hillside Real Estate
projectData.title: Seensa simannaa adda ta’e.
projectData.text:
Bocawwan 3D bal’inaan hojjetaman seensa mana jireenyaa gara balbala adda ta’etti jijjiiru. Ce’umsa magaalaa irraa gara manaatti taasifamu hawwataa godha.

Bocni kun utubaawwan irraa ka’ee hanga jala golgaa balbala seensaatti itti fufa. Guyyaa gad fageenyi paanaaliiwwan dachaafamanii ni mul’ata. Halkan immoo ifni ho’aan boca sana mul’isee balbala seensaa karaa irraa adda baasuuf gargaara.

projectData.name: Debre Birhan MESOB Center
projectData.title: Injinariingii sadarkaa guddaatti.
projectData.text:
Ethio Global Construction waliin hojjetame. Fuuldurri gamoo 238 m² kun qaama MESOB Center meetira 18 ol dheeratuuti. Hojiin TDL dizaayinii jalqabaa, oomishaa fi dhaabbii iddoo hojii hammate.

Dizaayinii irraa kaasee hanga oomishaafi dhaabbii paanaaliiwwaniitti Ethio Global Construction waliin hojjenne. Tarreewwan dhaabbataa fuula gamoo irratti irra deddeebi’u. Yeroo cinaa darbitan sibiilli dachaafame ifa bifa adda addaatiin calaqqisiisa.
